task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Lead and coordinate the empire-wide epidemic response: issue unified orders to all commanderies, set quarantine protocols, and prioritize the hardest-hit major cities.
Release emergency funds and grain reserves to affected cities, cover treatment costs, suspend taxes in stricken regions, and secure supply lines for food and medicine.
Mobilize imperial physicians and workshops to prepare and distribute medicines, and construct quarantine wards and treatment centers in major cities.
Enforce quarantine orders and travel restrictions, curb hoarding, price gouging, and unrest, and adjudicate violations swiftly to keep public order.
Dispatch censors to verify mortality reports and relief distribution, and prosecute concealment, neglect, or corruption by local officials.
